norms.what: One command for every transition: the source and target come first, so a new transition is a new knowledge file, not a new skill (#34). The rest of the arguments keep the grammar the per-transition audits had. Written for the transition-agnostic audit (#34, #42).

The slug names the knowledge file; saying whether it exists tells the user, before any cost, whether the known traps will run or the audit rests on the docs alone. Written for the transition-agnostic audit (#34, #42).

The command is `disable-model-invocation: true` so only the user starts an audit; the orchestrator it invokes is model-invocable, since Claude Code blocks Claude's call to a `disable-model-invocation` skill. Written for the transition-agnostic audit (#34, #42).
